clue.text: Ready for action, wife carrying weapons on horseback

parts.note: someone carrying weapons is armed
a jockey who is up is mounted on the horse

explanation.surface: A wife bearing arms and mounted on a horse is ready to charge into battle.
explanation.definitionFit: Idiom: an athlete who has loosened up is prepared for the action to begin.

clue.text: Go off, following women's swaying gait

indicators.note: following means coming after, so this piece is placed after the other

parts.note: W is the abbreviation for women
eggs that go off become addled, rotten

explanation.surface: Setting off behind the women, someone notices their rolling walk.
explanation.definitionFit: A duck-like rolling walk from side to side is this sort of gait.

clue.text: Much associated with this legendary outlaw

definitions.text: Much associated with this legendary outlaw

parts.words: Much associated with this legendary outlaw
parts.note: Much the Miller's Son is one of the Merry Men of Sherwood Forest, so the outlaw meant is their leader

explanation.surface: A legendary outlaw who is very much connected with the story.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Much' seems to mean 'greatly' but is the name of one of the Merry Men.
explanation.definitionFit: The Sherwood Forest outlaw of English legend who robbed the rich, with Much among his band.

clue.text: Record poem about island, part of series

indicators.note: about means around, so the record and poem go round the island

parts.note: an EP is an extended-play record
an ode is a lyric poem

explanation.surface: Someone records a poem about an island as one instalment of a series.
explanation.definitionFit: A single instalment of a television or radio serial is this.

clue.text: Belonging to a city, one in South Africa, not the capital

indicators.note: capital here means the capital letter heading the word, which is dropped

parts.note: Durban is a city in South Africa

explanation.surface: Something belonging to a South African city that is not the nation's capital.
explanation.walkthrough: 'not the capital' suggests Durban is not South Africa's capital, but it drops the initial letter.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: urban things relate to towns and cities rather than countryside.

clue.text: Whirling dervish, no doubt initially, could make one shudder

indicators.note: a whirling dervish spins, so the letters left are spun into a new order
no here says a letter is to be left out of the word dervish
initially points to the opening letter of the word doubt

explanation.surface: A spinning dervish is such a sight that it might send a tremor through the onlooker.
explanation.walkthrough: 'no' drops the D (from 'doubt initially') from DERVISH, leaving ERVISH, which 'Whirling' rearranges. 'could make one' is link text.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: a tremble of cold or fear is a shudder, both as noun and verb.

clue.text: Difficult securing first in Richmond (Virginia) university

indicators.note: securing means holding fast, so the outer word contains the others

parts.note: difficult means hard

indicators.note: first in picks out the opening letter of Richmond

parts.note: VA is the postal abbreviation for the US state of Virginia

explanation.surface: A hard-won place at a university in Richmond, Virginia.
explanation.definitionFit: Example: the oldest Ivy League university, in Cambridge, Massachusetts.

clue.text: I, for example, have unpaid bill that five pounds should cover?

indicators.note: covering means going round the outside, so these letters go around the others

parts.note: V is the Roman numeral five
L is the abbreviation for pounds sterling, from libra
to have an unpaid bill is to owe

explanation.surface: Someone with an unpaid bill wonders whether a fiver will cover it.
explanation.walkthrough: 'I' looks like the speaker but is the letter itself.
explanation.definitionFit: Example: the letter I is one of the five letters A E I O U.

clue.text: Kept back, being shy

definitions.meaning: held aside for someone, like a booked table
reticent and slow to reveal feelings

explanation.surface: Someone held back because of timidity.
explanation.definitionFit: A booked seat is kept back, and a reticent person is described with the same word.

clue.text: Panic this year in resort

indicators.note: read as re-sort, meaning sort again, so the letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: Alarm sweeps a holiday resort this year.
explanation.walkthrough: 'resort' looks like a seaside town but reads as re-sort.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: uncontrolled emotional excitement or fear, a panic.

clue.text: Seafood in pub brawny lads demolished

indicators.note: things demolished are knocked down and rebuilt, so these letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: Muscular lads wreck a pub, and with it the shellfish being served.
explanation.walkthrough: 'in' looks like a link word but is part of the fodder, supplying the I and N.
explanation.definitionFit: Example: these are langoustines, a shellfish sold as a seafood dish, also called scampi.

clue.text: A President // Ford car

definitions.meaning: Abraham, sixteenth head of state of the USA
a luxury marque owned by the Ford Motor Company

explanation.definitionFit: Abraham was a US head of state, and the Ford company makes luxury cars under that badge.

clue.text: Advertisement for American's caravan

definitions.meaning: a short preview advertising a forthcoming film
in the USA a towed home on wheels

explanation.surface: An advert offering a caravan for sale to a US buyer.
explanation.definitionFit: A film preview and, in US usage, a mobile home towed behind a car share this one word.

clue.text: Further extra to the other side

parts.note: extra means more, additional
to cross over is to go to the other side

explanation.surface: Instructions to go further, an extra distance across to the far side.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: as a sentence adverb, further means besides, in addition.

clue.text: Mostly win one with a queen

indicators.note: mostly means not quite all, so the final letter is dropped

parts.note: a win is a victory
I is the Roman numeral one

explanation.surface: Winning most of a card game by holding a queen.
explanation.definitionFit: Example: the British monarch who reigned from 1837 to 1901.

clue.text: Two infer second of daughters should be ignored

indicators.note: ignoring something means leaving it out, so this letter is dropped

parts.note: to infer is to deduce
D is the abbreviation for daughter; here the second D in the word is the one to go

explanation.surface: Two people infer something, while the second of their daughters gets overlooked.
explanation.walkthrough: 'second of daughters' says which D goes: DEDUCE has two, and dropping the second leaves the answer.
explanation.definitionFit: On dice and playing cards the two is called by this name.

clue.text: Fluctuating, with NI county ahead at first

indicators.note: at first means placed at the start, so this piece leads

parts.note: a team ahead is up, as in two up
with means and, together
Down is a county of Northern Ireland

explanation.surface: A Northern Irish county team keeps going ahead early then slipping.
explanation.definitionFit: Idiom: rising and falling alternately, as fortunes do.

clue.text: Comedian suppressing nasty oath over female — why should that be considered significant?

definitions.text: why should that be considered significant?

indicators.note: suppressing means holding down inside, so the other letters go within

parts.note: a wit is a comedian

indicators.note: nasty means unpleasant, so the letters of oath are mangled

explanation.surface: A comic stifles a vile oath at a woman, then shrugs it off.
explanation.walkthrough: 'nasty' shuffles the oath and 'suppressing' hides it, plus F, within the comedian; in a down entry 'over' just means the oath sits above the female.
explanation.definitionFit: Idiom: a dismissive retort asking why something should matter.

clue.text: Stall close to Welsh border

indicators.note: the close of a word is its final letter, here of Welsh

parts.note: a border is an edge

explanation.surface: A market stall sits just by the boundary between England and Wales.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Stall' looks like a market booth but is a verb: to evade or play for time.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: to avoid committing yourself, being evasive, is to stall.

clue.text: Went by end of terrace, outdated

indicators.note: end of picks the final letter of terrace

parts.note: a lapsed subscription is outdated, no longer valid

explanation.surface: Someone passed the end of an old-fashioned terrace of houses.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: time that has passed has gone by.

clue.text: Fabric of church beam a male bishop installed

indicators.note: installed means put in place within, so these letters go inside the others

parts.note: a ray is a beam of light
B is the chess notation for bishop

explanation.surface: Church cloth, a male bishop being installed under a beam.
explanation.definitionFit: A light plain-woven cotton cloth, rather like denim, often used for shirts.

clue.text: Delivery for doorman

definitions.meaning: in cricket, a ball bowled to rise sharply at the batsman
a guard at a nightclub door who throws people out

explanation.surface: Something delivered to the man on the door.
explanation.walkthrough: In cricket, a delivery is a ball bowled; a short-pitched one rearing up at the batter has this name.
explanation.definitionFit: A short rising cricket ball and a nightclub's heavy on the door share this name.

clue.text: Screen in restaurant on base

parts.note: a grill is a restaurant serving grilled food
e is the base of natural logarithms in mathematics

explanation.surface: A screen set up in a restaurant on its base.
explanation.definitionFit: A grating of bars across an opening serves as a protective screen.

clue.text: Having a hard time making a decision, a party in destructive wind

parts.words: Having a hard time making a decision
parts.note: someone undecided between options is torn
a do is a party

explanation.surface: Someone dithers about which party to attend while a gale rages.
explanation.definitionFit: Example: a violently rotating column of air that wrecks what lies in its path.

clue.text: Citrus fruit — not round variety

indicators.note: not means without, so the letter is taken away

parts.note: an orange is a citrus fruit
a round shape resembles the letter O

explanation.surface: A citrus fruit that is not round, a curious variety.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: a range of goods is a variety of them.

clue.text: Financial backer admitting love for architect

indicators.note: admitting means letting in, so one piece goes inside the other

parts.note: someone who provides money is a funder
love is zero in tennis, the letter O

explanation.surface: A sponsor puts up money for love of an architect's work.
explanation.definitionFit: Figurative sense: the architect of a scheme is the person who establishes and creates it.

clue.text: Cigarette all the rage for Dickensian villain

parts.note: fag is British slang for a cigarette
something fashionable is in

explanation.surface: Smoking was fashionable for a villain in a Dickens novel.
explanation.definitionFit: The receiver of stolen goods who trains child pickpockets in Oliver Twist.

clue.text: Teaching establishment getting rid of coach

parts.note: finishing off something means getting rid of it
to coach is to school, train

explanation.surface: A college plans to scrap its coach or tutor.
explanation.definitionFit: Example: a private college where young women were taught social graces and etiquette.

clue.text: Attempt to cover object with it

indicators.note: covering something means going round it, so one piece goes around the other

parts.note: an attempt is a try
an object is an end, an aim

explanation.surface: Instructions to try putting a cover on an object.
explanation.definitionFit: Idiom: being with it means being fashionable and up to date.

clue.text: New canteen about right for opening

indicators.note: about means surrounding, so the shuffled letters go around the other
something new is made afresh, so the letters of canteen are formed anew

explanation.surface: A new staff canteen is about to open on the right.
explanation.walkthrough: 'about' puts ENTANCE (the anagram of CANTEEN, from 'New') around R.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: a door or gateway giving access is an opening.
